title: A weight-two Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $n\ge 2$. There exists a nonzero vector $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$ whose support has cardinality $2$ and whose vector Fourier coefficient with respect to the constant-pair probability density is $1$.
